Config.description: Config maps an environment name to the Grafana server, org and credentials gcx is run against.

urlForward.description:
URLForward replaces URL with the local address of a kubectl port-forward
to the given target. The env name is used as the kubectl cluster name.

env.description: Env to pass to the cli

tokenCmd.description: TokenCmd to execute returning the token

ConfigEnv.description: ConfigEnv is a single gcx environment: the Grafana server, org, credential source, optional urlForward target, and extra environment variables passed to the gcx CLI.

cluster.description: Cluster to use for the kubectl command

resource.description: Resource pod or service, e.g. svc/grafana

namespace.description: Namespace of the target pod or service

profile.description: Profile to use for the kubectl command, optional

PortForwardTarget.description: PortForwardTarget identifies the pod or service a kubectl port-forward is opened against to reach a server only reachable from inside the cluster.
